summary: Three review passes completed. Official road acquisition and branch reliability checks succeeded; the complete nuisance audit and promotion remain blocked by missing true four-block membership and comparable current-best OOF evidence. No candidate passed all promotion gates; no weekly slot was used.

checks: Official road classifier allowlist was checked against the Census 2024 MTFCC technical documentation; internal-use S1750 and unknown/non-road classes are excluded and counts recorded.

Area1/Area2, geological proxies, label-derived seams, MRDS, geothermal wells, sinter, vents and probes are excluded from nuisance features; four-block membership is never fabricated.

Non-wrapping shift null, geometry-only support rejection, valid-shift count, classifier refits, four spatial folds, Holm adjustment and effect-size threshold were inspected; tails are labelled approximate stationarity diagnostics, not exact p-values.
Scale-space tests cover zero-height/constant preservation, high-frequency attenuation, missing-value restoration, bounded persistence and invalid parameters.
H24-3A training-label negatives are selected using training-region labels only; component exclusion reaches the entire touching component, and all arms use identical folds/settings.
Candidate file SHA-256 is tied to format checks and the exact C2ST input. It passes GeoTIFF format only; upload eligibility remains false.
All 61 pytest tests pass; Ruff check and format pass; compileall passes; git diff --check passes.
Generated Pages links checked: 64 internal references resolve; offline source-feed schema check passes. No browser interaction or live deployment is claimed.
